# tf-drift-check

> Detect Terraform drift from the resource_drift section of plan JSON: attribute paths that changed outside Terraform, deletions, ignore rules, values never printed Go module `github.com/Trysac/u281-tf-drift-check`, package `tfdriftcheck`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
